source_snapshot.procedure: Disable NUMA balancing; log eight AGT indices and BMC ambient/fan/PSU at 1 s/continuous cadence; idle 3 minutes; run RVS GST for 30 minutes then kill; idle at least 1 minute; correlate/graph logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: No hang/reset/offline/overheat or unacceptable throttling; 750 W power cap per GPU; source machine time is 720 minutes.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL reduces the case to an unspecified 12h stress plus rocm-smi and loses the literal AGT/BMC/RVS synchronization.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Identifies 12-hour title/machine-time versus 30-minute literal RVS conflict and requires exact schedule, config, NUMA restore, sampling/timebase, thresholds and load recovery.

old_problem: The title and 720-minute machine time require a 12-hour thermal soak, but the only executable workload step says run and kill RVS after 30 minutes; these have materially different thermal steady-state coverage.
disposition_reason: ED-14 prohibits a short smoke run from replacing formal long-duration coverage, so the 30-minute step cannot satisfy the 12-hour case. However, no approved source defines whether RVS runs continuously for 12 hours, repeats 30-minute cycles, or the 30-minute segment is a separate checkpoint. Inventing that schedule would alter load/coverage and recovery semantics.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row159 all18 XLSX cells and history2765.
Applied ED-14 to preserve the formal 12-hour requirement and reject DeepSeek's vague replacement.
Preserved exact NUMA/AGT/BMC/RVS/idle/correlation coverage but retained the unresolved workload schedule. No load, NUMA or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: Twelve-hour GPU thermal soak pending authoritative 30-minute segment schedule
test_case.purpose: Demonstrate twelve-hour all-GPU thermal/power stability with synchronized AGT GPU PM/hotspot/GFXCLK, BMC ambient/fan/PSU and RVS DGEMM performance evidence, while retaining the source's 30-minute segment as an unresolved scheduling element.
required_package: Authoritative schedule reconciling 12 hours/720 minutes with the 30-minute RVS kill step
Pinned RVS GST 12-hour config, AGT artifact/index-to-GPU map and ROCm/driver versions
Correct NUMA balancing disable command, original-state capture and restore procedure
BMC ambient/fan/PSU sensor map, units, cadence and shared timebase
750 W per-GPU cap interpretation, throttle/GFLOP/temperature limits, cooling/PSU/abort/OOB recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not execute until the 12-hour versus 30-minute schedule is approved. Then preserve the specified 3-minute pre-idle, authorized RVS segment/loop/continuous schedule totaling the formal 12-hour coverage, at least 1-minute post-idle, 1 s AGT logging for indices 0,5,10,15,20,25,30,35, continuous BMC logging and common-timebase correlation. Record and restore the original NUMA balancing state.
test_case.expected_result: The approved 12-hour schedule completes with all GPUs online, no hang/reset/overheat or unacceptable throttling, each GPU within the approved 750 W interpretation and thermal/GFLOP limits, synchronized system telemetry, and restored NUMA state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the authoritative 12-hour schedule, full-duration synchronized evidence and all approved thresholds. A single 30-minute run or vague 12-hour stress log cannot pass.
safety_gate: Formal long-duration all-GPU load requires explicit approval, cooling/PSU headroom and OOB monitoring.
Capture and restore NUMA balancing; correct the malformed source path only through approved procedure.
Pin AGT indices to stable GPU UUID/BDF identities and verify BMC sensor semantics.
Abort on GPU offline, hang/reset, thermal/power cap, sustained throttle, XID/ECC/link/kernel/BMC fault or lost telemetry; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: RVS config/artifact and AGT index-to-UUID/BDF map
Synchronized AGT, BMC and RVS/GFLOP logs including idle signatures
12-hour coverage timeline, graphs, threshold comparison, health logs and final idle state
test_case.recovery: Stop tracked workload/loggers on abort, preserve all partial synchronized evidence, restore NUMA balancing to its recorded original value, verify GPU/system health and use only approved OOB/service recovery. Do not restart the soak automatically.

source_conflict.reason: The 12-hour title/720-minute machine time and literal 30-minute RVS kill step remain materially inconsistent; ED-14 forbids treating them as equivalent.

blocked.reason: Static review is complete; execution is prohibited until the authoritative long-duration schedule and recovery are defined.
